newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat closes lower after late volatility.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat closes lower after late volatility.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed lower after the market showed life late and moved on either side of Thursday's settlement then dropped into the close, traders said.
"We had some gyrations late when buying showed up in Chicago but they sold it off late," a trader said.

A late turn upward in CBOT corn futures underpinned the market but hedge selling and profit taking amid signs the wheat market was technically overbought for the short term capped the late attempt to rally prices, they said.
"Weather markets led corn and beans higher this week but we could drop another eight cents unless Chicago takes off again (next week)," the trader said.
Technicians said there was resistance in the September at $3.72 to $3.73.
"A close below $3.68 could put it into a downtrend," a trader said during the session. The September closed at $3.68-1/2, down 2-3/4 cents.
Some underpinning may have come from news this week the EU imposed a tax on its wheat exports.
KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed 1/4 to 2-3/4 cents lower, with December down 2-1/4 at $3.84.
Wheat futures volume was estimated by the KCBT at 31,875 contracts, below the 47,020 traded Thursday.
